deviations.claim_in_article: Meta executives admitted that this way of starting the test was a “mistake.”
deviations.issue: Ledger identifies the speaker more specifically as the vice president of Meta’s Superintelligence Labs, while the article broadens this to plural “Meta executives.”
deviations.explanation: The admission and its substance are preserved, but the speaking actor is broadened from one identified executive to multiple unspecified executives.
